## Change

Describe the user-visible result and why it was needed.

## Verification

- Affected workflow exercised, including the visible result:
- Focused checks and `bun run check` result, or why a check does not apply:
- Installed build and desktop check when required by [development](../docs/development.md#verification-and-handoff):
- Unverified behavior or remaining limits:

## Review notes

Call out data migrations, provider calls, changed release behavior, or an intentionally separate follow-up. Keep logs and examples redacted.
